title: Invertibility of the finite counit comparison
statement: For the finite coefficient extension and finite-field datum used by def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core, the intrinsic finite counit comparison finiteU is an isomorphism at every normalized quotient level.

proof.text: Use the finite-free coefficient-extension basis calculation to identify the scalar-extended finite dualizing counit with the finite counit comparison. The exceptional adjunction mate, the compact-support coefficient comparison, and the normalized realization maps are isomorphisms; closure of isomorphisms under composition and transport through the adjunction gives IsIso finiteU at every quotient level, including ramified and identity levels.
